(AP Photo/Matt Freed)Comment on this story1CommentShare storySharetopics: BrewersMLBStreamingCableSatelliteSubscriptionBroadcastTelevisionMILWAUKEE (WLUK) -- Brewers fans who have cable, satellite or streaming will be able to watch games this year.The Brewers released a channel finder Thursday morning ahead of the season-opening game. Telecasts will be available on carriers including DirecTV, Xfinity/Comcast, Spectrum, AT&T U-verse and Fubo.Fans who do not have cable or satellite TV can buy a streaming package directly from the Brewers. On Monday, the team announced a monthly subscription option, which costs $19.99.
